# rbind dataframes or matrices with different lengths or collumn names

rbind dataframes or matrices with different lengths or collumn names

## Usage

``` r
rbind_all(df1, df2)
```

## Arguments

- df1:

  dataframe or matrix

- df2:

  dataframe or matrix

## Examples

``` r
df1<-generate_correlation_matrix(n=10)
df2<-generate_correlation_matrix(n=10)
names(df2)[4]<-"X11"
rbind_all(df1=df1,df2=df2)
```
